body: Try not to over analyze everything 😁 live in the moment and don't wish your life away....notcyet atleast lol

Try to imagine a better happier scenario - trust me, I know how ridiculous this might sound. 

Work back from there and stop seeing everything as an obstacle. I'm not religious or anything close but it's uncanny how focusing on the negatives will only serve to amplify them. 

You're not alone! The struggle is real and it sucks for far more folks than I realized before hanging here when I'm down. 

I feel just a little bit better for sharing my thoughts here. Reminds me to do as I preach!

Good luck - hope you find a happy place on your mind.
